data.long_meaning: Annorah is derived from the Hebrew word 'hennarah', which means 'grace, favor'. In the Bible, the name Annorah is not explicitly mentioned, but the concept of God's grace and favor is a central theme throughout the scriptures. The name Annorah carries the meaning “Grace, Favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Annorah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
